findings.claim: The requirement says MessagePack attributes on T must be honoured, and ledger L19 says to follow the requirement. When no SurrogateType is set, the collector always uses CreateContractlessMembers and isIntKey=false. As a result, [IgnoreMember] on a public read-write member of T is still serialized. A T marked [MessagePackObject] with [Key(n)] members also gets a string-keyed map formatter instead of the int-keyed array contract it declares, so the bytes differ from what T's own contract and the dynamic resolver produce.

receipt_plan.detail: Run Receipts.GeneratedTests.GeneratedFormatterEdgeCaseTests.IgnoreMemberOnFormattedTypeIsHonoured: the generated ThirdPartyFormatter body references 'Secret'. Run KeyAttributesOnReferencedTypeAreHonoured: the generated formatter for a metadata [MessagePackObject] type with [Key(0)]/[Key(1)] contains WriteMapHeader.

findings.claim: IsPartial validates only the formatter class itself. Consider a formatter nested in a non-partial containing type, e.g. `static class Formatters { [GeneratedMessagePackFormatter] public partial class F : IMessagePackFormatter<T> {} }`. It passes every check, and the generated file re-opens the nesting type as `partial class Formatters`, which gives CS0260 (or CS0535 if the nesting is not emitted). No MsgPack019 is reported. Two related shapes are also never checked: a private nested formatter, or one without an accessible parameterless constructor, cannot be instantiated by the resolver; a generic formatter class cannot be instantiated without type arguments. Both are accepted silently.

receipt_plan.detail: Run Receipts.GeneratedTests.GeneratedFormatterEdgeCaseTests.NestedFormatterInNonPartialTypeIsDiagnosedOrCompiles: the generator reports no diagnostic, yet the output compilation has errors.

findings.claim: The new filter removes [GeneratedMessagePackFormatter] classes from the hand-written formatter list, so their data type T is no longer in options.KnownFormatters. Suppose T is declared in the same assembly without [MessagePackObject] (the requirement says 'even when' T is in a referenced assembly, so a same-assembly T is in scope) and T is used as a member of a [MessagePackObject] type. TypeCollector then reaches the MessagePackObject requirement for T and reports MsgPack003, even though a formatter for T is generated and registered.

receipt_plan.detail: Write a VerifyCS.Test (SkipGeneratedSourcesCheck) with these sources: `public class MyType { public int A { get; set; } }`, `[GeneratedMessagePackFormatter] public partial class MyTypeFormatter : IMessagePackFormatter<MyType> { }`, `[MessagePackObject] public class Holder { [Key(0)] public MyType Value { get; set; } }` and a [GeneratedMessagePackResolver]. Expect no diagnostics; on head an unexpected MsgPack003 on Holder.Value is expected.

findings.claim: CreateSurrogateMembers iterates GetInstanceMembers(surrogate). That covers every non-static field and property of any accessibility, including private helper fields and members inherited from the surrogate's base classes. Any such member without [Key] or [IgnoreMember] aborts generation with MsgPack004. MsgPack004 normally applies only to public members (L5), so a surrogate with a private field or a base class fails with no generated formatter.

receipt_plan.detail: Use a surrogate `class S { private int helper; [Key(0)] public int A { get; set; } }` with a T that has public read-write A. Drive the generator and assert that it reports no MsgPack004 and that a ThirdPartyFormatter source is emitted; on head MsgPack004 is reported on 'helper'.

findings.claim: The ForAttributeWithMetadataName predicate accepts only ClassDeclarationSyntax, but AttributeUsage(AttributeTargets.Class) also permits `partial record`. A `[GeneratedMessagePackFormatter] partial record F : IMessagePackFormatter<T>;` is silently ignored: no MsgPack019/020 diagnostic and no body, so the user only sees CS0535.

receipt_plan.detail: Drive the generator with LanguageVersion.Latest on `[GeneratedMessagePackFormatter] public partial record F : IMessagePackFormatter<MyType>;`. Assert that either a formatter source is generated or a MsgPack diagnostic is reported; on head neither happens.
